$comment: What the shared scripts in scripts/ need to know about this project. It is the only file a project edits to adopt the kit's scripts; the scripts themselves stay byte-identical with the kit's (scripts/sync.ps1 keeps them so). Folders are relative to this folder, with forward slashes and a trailing slash. 'kit' is the kit folder, relative to this one; '.' means this project is the kit. See scripts/kit-config.ps1 for every key.
